description: OV Haltes Den Haag is a dataset listed in Gemeente Data Portaal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Gemeente 's-Gravenhage. Beschrijving: De OV-halte kaart is een samengesteld product van leveringen van diverse exploitanten die in de gemeente Den Haag opereren. De brondata is afkomstig van het NDOV loket en vervolgens bewerkt door DSO/PSO van de gemeente Den Haag. Coverage: a Dutch municipality (Gemeente data portal). The portal files it under Government and public sector. The portal shows 1,630 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gemeente-intodq2-portal.
